messages.text: Allergic to almonds. Definitely confirmed via skin test, no question.
Got it — almonds out across the board.
Planning a six-day backpacking trip in the Sierras. Food planning is killing me — calories per ounce matters.

Backcountry food calculus: target ~3,500-4,500 calories per day depending on effort, ~1.5-2 lbs of food per day total. Focus on calorie-dense items (nut butters, oils, full-fat dairy if you can keep it, dried fruits, freeze-dried meals).

For your case: pre-portion everything by day in ziploc bags. Stove-cook breakfasts and dinners; cold lunches on the trail. Snacks every two hours.
Snack recipe? I'd like to make something at home to bring.

## No-Bake Energy Bars

Dense, calorie-packed, perfect for the trail.

In a food processor, pulse 1 cup chopped almonds, 1 cup pitted dates, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/4 cup honey, 1/4 cup almond butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp cinnamon until it forms a sticky paste. Press into a parchment-lined 8x8 pan. Refrigerate 2 hours. Cut into 12 bars. Each is roughly 200 calories. Wrap individually in parchment for the trail.
